notes.title: Beach Bounce Loyalty Discount
notes.content:
Hi all, first of all a big thanks for buying at some stage Sword of Asumi, I am now happy to say we have officially released our second title on Steam.

[h1]Beach Bounce[/h1]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/352010/

And as an extra special bonus, all owners of Sword of Asumi are getting double the normal release discount if they order the game in the first week of release as an extra special thanks for your loyalty to our games.

This will give owners of Sword of Asumi a total of 40% off the game if they buy the game in its first week of release.

[h1]Episodic Play[/h1]

To make Beach Bounce that much better we are releasing it in episodic format, so the first episode is available immediately.

Episode 2 will then be released as a free update on October 12th and Episode 3 as another free update on December 14th.

But you might want to buy sooner as not only is the game on discount now, but it is also at the lower price, since as we release more content we will be increasing the price in line with the extra content.

The soundtrack is also available for a 20% discount during launch week.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/394050/

notes.title: Bundle Offer & Upcoming Release
notes.content:
Two great announcements for you all today.

[h1]1) IndieGala Bundle[/h1]

I am happy to announce for anyone still waiting for the right time to get Sword of Asumi... The time is now, as Sword of Asumi is part of IndieGala's weekly bundle.

In their current Doujin bundle they have a range of great titles including the Deluxe edition of Sword of Asumi for an unbeatable price as well as other great indie titles.

Check out the bundle here:
https://www.indiegala.com/monday

[h1]2) Upcoming Release[/h1]

In addition we can now confirm our release date for Beach Bounce is Friday 14th August 2015. Just ten days away now. On release you will have access to episode 1 of 3, with the other two episodes being released as free updates in October and December for you to enjoy. (no extra hidden fees).

There are two ways to own Beach Bounce

1) Order the game on Steam upon release. Everyone will get a 20% discount on the $15.99 steam edition except for Sword of Asumi owners.
Sword of Asumi owners will be extra special and will get double discount if they order it in its week of release, giving you up to 40% off the game on Steam.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/352010/

2) Alternatively you can order the slightly more 'risque' version of the game on MangaGamer, pre-orders for which are already open on their website. On MangaGamer you can pre-order the game with a 20% discount from the slightly more expensive price of $17.95.

http://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=148

Whichever version you buy you will be entitled to all future episodes and updates at no extra charge. If you wait the price of the games may well increase as more episodes are released.

notes.title: Update 2.03
notes.content:
A very very minor update removing a few very very minor bugs that should have been removed in earlier updates but seemed to keep getting missed mostly by accident.

The main bugs are minor fixed in this update are a few grammar errors and name appearance issues. I would like to say this will be the final update but I am sure others will slowly appear out of the wood work one day soon, until then it is the final.

Also a quick note we have finally removed the credits for 'voice actors' in the game, sorry for the confusion this should have been removed some time ago, for various reasons we were unable to implement the voice acting which is why there were no options for it and why it is never included as a feature.
the credits have been overlooked for sometime but have now been rectified.

There are a number of reasons we couldn't include the voice acting in the development and so I wont go into detail here, if interested I live stream every saturday on youtube, please ask me then and I will explain gladly.

Thanks for reading.

notes.title: Divine Slice of Life on Kickstarter
notes.content:
Hi all, I am happy to announce that our latest game 'Divine Slice of Life' is currently being funded on Kickstarter. 

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/kirito/divine-slice-of-life][img]http://orig01.deviantart.net/5367/f/2015/145/b/7/divine_logo_by_dharker-d8unsmo.png[/img][/url]

The new games story revolves around Aaki the protagonist whose humble life gets torn apart when he meets two enraged demi-gods on his walk home from uni. The two then need little encouragement to harass Aaki by never leaving his side again...

The game will feature two demi gods as well as a collection of university students several of whom have eyes for the protagonist. This cute slice of life story with a divine twist will let you decide how it unfolds and whether Aaki ends up happy or sad at the games conclusion.

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/kirito/divine-slice-of-life][img]http://orig01.deviantart.net/c8aa/f/2015/144/f/d/photo_original_by_dharker-d8unsgq.png[/img][/url]

You can help support this game, get early access and other rewards by supporting the kickstarter campaign by following this link:

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/kirito/divine-slice-of-life

[h1]Update:[/h1]

We have now met our primary target and have offered several stretch goals which will add extra content to the games final release. So backing the campaign will not only get you great rewards but also make the game larger and more interesting to play.

notes.title: Errors & Missing Executables!
notes.content:
Hi we have had a few people posting support tickets when the game shows Missing Executable or comes up with an error.

After testing this extensively we have found that some of the lib dlls in the game that were added as part of the steam achievement update can create false positives with some virus programs. (E.g. Avast, Norton etc)

When this occurs the virus program either quarantines or deletes the exe game file or removes the dll files, which will then stop the game from working. To fix this issue and restore the game content you need to do the following:

1. Temporarily disable your vrius scanner
2. Right click on Sword of Asumi in your steam library
3. Select properties
4. Go to the Local Files tab
5. Click on 'Verify Integrity of Game Cache

Steam will then authenticate the files and download the corrupted or missing ones from the false positive. After which your game will work again.

To prevent this occurring again you will need to either temporarily disable the virus scanner for playing or set an exception for these files.

Request:
In addition we have submitted these as false positives to some companies, but if you receive the virus notification then please also submit a false positive report to your virus provider.

If we find a different way to package the game that does not create these false positives then we will post an update once performed.

notes.title: Achievements & Steam Sale
notes.content:
I am happy to announce a number of extra's for the Sword of Asumi game.

First in honor of the Swords of Edo second anniversary we have been able to give Sword of Asumi a final update. The recently released update polishes the main gameplay and fixes the final bugs we have been notified of. This includes an update to the soundtrack DLC to ensure it displays correctly in Steam Player.

In addition we have added 22 Steam achievements to the game for you to try and reach. In order to receive these you will need to replay the game after updating.

[h1]Steam Sale[/h1]

Since we have now released our final major update and this is the Swords of Edo's second anniversary we felt it only fitting to place the game on sale in the hope of allowing many more people to play the game.

This sale will begin tomorrow '16th March' and will continue for one week.

[h1]Sequel[/h1]

We have also agreed that if we can sell over 5,000 copies of the Sword of Asumi game during this sale and before the end of March then a sequel will be put into production that will follow Asumi's exploits after the end of the graphic novel (included in one of the current DLC packs).

http://store.steampowered.com/app/331491/

[h1]Deluxe Edition[/h1]

Last but not least tomorrow we will also be looking to release a deluxe edition of the Sword of Asumi that will include all of the DLC packs in one complete package, with the aim to also include any future DLC we release for the game as well.

Checkout and order the game now before the sale ends to help us achieve these goals and take the games storyline even further...

http://store.steampowered.com/app/326950/

notes.title: Soundtrack & Game Update
notes.content:
Today we have updated the game with a lot of polishing, removing unnecessary features and fixing every bug we have been apprised of previously.

The game is now in it's most efficient form to prevent any lagging issues or slowdown within the game.

In addition we have re-ordered the soundtrack DLC so that the information represented within the Steam Music Player is fully up to date, showing all tracks in the correct order with the correct artist details.

We will continue to work on an update for the character creator to coincide with our sale offer and deluxe edition release next week.

notes.title: Sale & Update Incoming
notes.content:
Greetings everyone, so over the past few weeks we have been working on a final update to the Sword of Asumi game, which we are aiming to release on the 16th March.

The update will polish up the graphics of the game, remove some superfluous options and cast aside some unnecessary coding to reduce the game size a little and make the game run more efficiently.

In addition we are aiming to simultaneously release an update to the soundtrack (so that it appears in the correct order in SteamPlayer and another update to the Character Creator to add some male characters.

All of which should go live on the 16th March.

To celebrate these updates the game will also be going on offer for the week of these final updates And we are launching a deluxe edition of the game that includes all of the DLC at a better rate. After these updates are released we will be focusing on the release of our next game...

http://store.steampowered.com/app/352010/

Which is currently seeking more funding on Kickstarter

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/ajtilley/beach-bounce

notes.title: Update version 1.10
notes.content:
We have now uploaded and released our second update since release, but the first major update. This patch sees the correction of several large bugs, some missing code and the correction of a major bug that was preventing some choices from being registered.

From feedback we have also reduced the difficulty of getting some of the endings to prevent the game from being too frustrating.

Those who have already played the game may well find it much more interactive now that we have resolved these issues.

notes.title: Steam Beta v110
notes.content:
This update has already been on Steam for about 24 hours and it seems mostly stable, there are still a lot of bugs but it is definitely a massive improvement over the previous updates...

Main Changes

[list]
[*] Old Licensed Soundtrack removed and replaced with new unique soundtrack.
[*] General alterations to the main menu to prevent music stopping.
[*] Removed variable un-lockables from codex (decided it was no needed)
[*] Entire script and all bonus scenes and 98% of character art added.
[*] Added additional gallery CG scenes from the game.
[*] Updated the Music Room to play the new sound tracks.
[/list]

Work continues we have now received most of the 'female' voice acting and are just waiting on the last of the male characters, voice work will start to be added to the game alongside sound effects whilst we continue to fix bugs and smooth out the standard game delivery.

notes.title: Release DLC
notes.content:
I am happy to announce that on release of the game we will now have three pieces of DLC available for everyone to enjoy. These do not add anything to the game, but will give you non-game benefits...

[list]
[*][h1]Swords of Edo Graphic Novel[/h1]

notes.title: How Update during Beta Work
notes.content:
A few people have asked how the beta updates work, so I thought I should give you all a run down of roughly how updates work and why they mostly appear over the weekend.

Currently I have set the development of the game in the following stages:

[list]
[*] Artwork & Scripting
[*] Game Coding
[*] Bugfixes & animation
[*] Voice Acting & Music[/list]

[b]Stage 1 Artwork and Scripting[/b] is now complete [i](mostly)[/i] we have a full script from start to finish and 80% of the artwork, those missing pieces are gradually being added as we move into stage 2.

[b]Stage 2 is Game coding[/b], which is what we are on now. Essentially this means taking the artwork and script and coding it into the game.
I do this by the following method:

[b]Monday-Friday[/b] = I spend a lot of time each day coding the script into game code, usually in notebook or other editor programs, my aim is to get about 15-25% of the script into code each week.

[b]On Friday[/b] I upload this code to steam;
This includes the script, backgrounds, some CG scenes variables and choices, as well as some character artwork.

[b]On Saturday and Sunday[/b] I then go through all of the code I uploaded and fix bugs, some based on what is reported to me, others based on what I find, I also make sure all backgrounds and character sprites are appearing correctly.
[i]N.b. I however don't include animations or worry about sprite overlaps.[/i]

[b]On Sunday[/b] I upload the new version of the game, which should be a stable bug free release of the current content. When satisfied this is also uploaded DRM free to AJTilley.com [i](if not satisifed the DRM free version will wait till the following week as needed)[/i]

And then the process starts over with the next chunk of script.

[b]Stage 3 is Bugfixing & animations[/b], once the entire script is in the game I then most focus on ensuring all the routes are working, which is tantamount to fixing coding bugs. Once that is done I will focus entirely on animations, importing all the CG scenes I can or making space for them and animating all the characters as much as possible. Essentially to make the game look as good as possible. Any final character art will be updated at this stage as well.

[b]Finally Stage 4[/b], Is where all that is left to add is the voiceacting, final sound effects and of course the new musical score. Most of this will be uploaded during January 2015 in preparation for the steam release. Chances are we will also put he games updates on hold during this phase, and then release an update with the full and final game 1 week prior to its official release, to find any last minute bugs and to give beta backers the game one week before everyone else.

So that in a nutshell is how development works and what it involves. I am very happy with this process and expect it to continue through the next three months until we release the game. So expect large content updates weekly for now and into December.
